en: Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are ploughed fields leading up to dense clusters of houses with gabled roofs. A prominent church with a baroque-style tower and onion dome rises above the town center. At the top left, in red Gothic-style script, is the printed caption 'Deutsch-Beneschau von Osten' on an otherwise blank sky background.
